# AI Novel Studio — GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository contains a reusable continuity engine and separate story roots. Read root `AGENTS.md`, `ENGINE_E3_E4.md`, and `docs/AGENT_RUNBOOK.md` for current workflows; `ENGINE_E2.md` defines schemas/replay and `ENGINE_E1.md` defines story-root compatibility. Story-specific instructions and data live under `stories/<slug>/`. Never import another story's rules, style, or history. Engine-only tasks must use synthetic metadata and create no narrative prose.

Install pinned dependencies from official PyPI as documented in `AGENTS.md`. Use `python scripts/storyctl.py --story <slug> check`, `pack <scene-id>`, or `status`. `brief-review <scene-id> --base HEAD` prepares local review evidence; `doctor` reports local diagnostics; `propose` is an alias for `proposal`. Legacy invocations resolve the default from `studio.json`; explicit `--root` datasets remain supported. Run both validators and `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

Scope each handoff to the selected story, target, actual HEAD/base, and current draft digest. A working draft can differ from HEAD. Local bundles are unreviewed evidence and can include unpublished material. New review/doctor file output stays under workspace `.local/`; do not attach it to public PRs without explicit user authorization. Structural checks do not authenticate human approval, verify GitHub settings or CODEOWNERS enforcement, or assess prose quality. Never promote proposals or planned beats into approved history. Writer/reviewer/updater output remains advisory until an authorized human decision; rollup and authenticated approval remain deferred.
